baselines.note: Need >= 60 daily origins (distinct UTC dates) for statistical conclusions; current: 29. Hourly verification targets within a single prediction are NOT independent samples.
baselines.metric_definition: mae_log_return_pct and rmse_log_return_pct are 100 * |log(forecast/origin) - log(actual/origin)| averaged over verified horizons. Scale-free. direction_accuracy = fraction of horizons where sign(log-return forecast) == sign(log-return actual), relative to forecast origin.
